assessments.reasoning: The official Plain Text body and byte pin identify the exact document. Its measured footer, corroborated by the commit-pinned control, explicitly dedicates the license text under CC0 and refers to the publisher's policies. The footer directly establishes the license-text dedication. Coverage of the accompanying publisher notices depends on the policy's broader wording. [Publisher Plain Text](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt)

The controlled publisher policy at lines 76–81 expressly places legal code, notices, and accompanying license-page text under CC0 and reserves trademarks and branding. Applying that textual scope to the matching introductory, disclaimer, footer, and contact text in the publisher's linked Plain Text format supports whole-file copyright reuse. The policy's integrity check is for the rendered statement. [Publisher policy](https://creativecommons.org/policies/)

challenge.method: I inspected the full publisher Plain Text acquisition and the live Web representation, compared the reported byte count and digest with the repository control, and traced the introduction, opening disclaimer, closing notice, and contact line against the rendered license page, Legal Code Defined, the licensing statement, and CC0 §§2–4.
challenge.results: Legal Code Defined excludes the informational introduction, opening disclaimer, and closing publisher notice from the operative instrument. The licensing statement independently covers their text and the accompanying contact line, which appears immediately after the closing notice in both publisher formats. The general site CC BY rule expressly excepts these texts. The trademark reservation governs a separate right, and Section 3 governs the sharing of works under CC BY. Neither boundary contradicts the claim's copyright-only reading. The measured footer range [17584,18598) matched the repository control, with SHA-256 d6a26138589790799e3d093348bfa810523c441d46b704ac1bc0e3358f852929. The contact line falls in the separately measured [18598,18657) range, outside that footer range and inside the full-file pin. [Legal Code Defined](https://creativecommons.org/legal-code-defined/) [Publisher policy](https://creativecommons.org/policies/) [Rendered legal-code page](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.en)

limitations: The conclusion applies to the exact digest-pinned Plain Text file. The rendered site and works licensed under CC BY are outside the claim.
Creative Commons reserves trademark and branding rights. CC0 §4 also preserves patent rights, disclaims warranties, and leaves third-party rights clearance outside the dedication.
The byte comparison uses the acquisition tool's measurements on the original response and the repository control. The Web rendering was inspected for content and supplied no byte digest.
reasoning: The exact publisher Plain Text acquisition returned a complete byte payload and measured 18,657 bytes with SHA-256 9ba9550ad48438d0836ddab3da480b3b69ffa0aac7b7878b5a0039e7ab429411, matching the claim's pin and the commit-pinned publisher repository control. The file footer declares the license-text dedication, and the publisher's licensing statement expressly extends CC0 to the notices and accompanying text on its license pages. Those notices appear in the official Plain Text format. CC0 §2 waives the affirmer's copyright and related rights to the extent permitted, and §3 supplies a fallback license where the waiver is ineffective. Together they support copyright redistribution of the exact file.
